job: Replace broken left rear door roll-up glass
result_summary: No manual source covers removing or installing the rear door roll-up glass. LEMON 940 books cover the door panel, condensation trap and window motor; a LEMON 740 book covers the rear door lift mechanism; VIDA 2014D has one 700/900 bulletin (guide mouldings). The glass steps came from the Volvo Club UK 700/900 FAQ.

searches.note: No page title in this book contains 'glass'; hits were wiring, locks, labor times.

tool_findings.finding: The model/year filter is approximate. For 940 it returns P2-era and C70 documents. Check each document's figures or cross-references before using it.
model and year are required; there is no unfiltered title search.
Calls need an MCP session: initialize, then send mcp-session-id on each request, or the server answers 400 'Missing session ID'.
Matches page titles only. The 1994 940 base sedan book has no body-glass titles; the engine-coded B230FD book has a Windows and Glass section with TSBs only.
Intermediate folders such as .../Repair and Diagnosis/Body & Frame/ return 404; use find, or browse a path find returned.
